TIBT 100.description: Concepts, grammar, syntax of spoken and written Tibetan for beginners. Also covers aspects of Tibetan worldview.

TIBT 101.description: Focus on grammar, syntax, and structures to improve comprehension and communication skills. Also covers aspects of Tibetan worldview. Recommended pre-requisite: TIBT 100.

TIBT 300.description: The basics of classical Tibetan grammar and vocabulary, with readings from a selection of daily prayer verses. Recommended pre-requisite: completion of TIBT 100 or TIBT 390 with a minimum grade of 60%.

TIBT 301.description: Continuation of introductory classical Tibetan grammar and vocabulary, with selected readings to strengthen one's foundation in classical Tibetan. Recommended pre-requisite: completion of TIBT 300 with a minimum grade of 60%.

TIBT 390.course_name: Tibetan Language in a Community Context
TIBT 390.description: Beginner to conversational level Tibetan combined with experiential learning and cultural activities at local Tibetan community sites. Interactive practice with everyday phrases, grammar structure, and vocabulary with Tibetan community members.
